pairs.why: B has a soft, low-detail spotlight background like the real stage, whereas A has hard radial ray bands behind the kit; both have crisp hardware edges.
Both have a busy caustic net of edges in the water that the real card's soft ripples lack, but B's larger, bolder pier with fewer fine edges is nearer to the real hero edge density.
B's darker navy truss with soft glow merges more like the real dark rig; A's light grey truss with crisp vents and bright lines is edgier.
B has fewer tiny knob and slider edges and a calmer surface, closer to the real mixer's few soft internal lines; A is busier with crisp small details.
A's darker, denser leaf clusters read as softer massed edges like the real bush, while B's big light leaves have crisp bright rims.
Both slippers have similarly soft rim edges and crisp dot bumps, and the backgrounds have equal stripe edges, so edges give no reason to choose.
A keeps the soft smooth sand background and clean thin seams like the real ball, while B's grainy sand has high edge density and a crisp seam notch near the cap.
B has fewer plank grooves and fewer crisp fold lines than A, closer to the real card's single soft floor seam and soft glove creases.
